The 2 oz (.308) Silver Bullet offered by Bullion Trading LLC is a unique and striking product that will appeal to gun enthusiasts and collectors alike. Made from .999 pure silver, this silver bullet is a great investment option for those looking to diversify their portfolio.
The bullet is modeled after the .308 Winchester round, which is a popular and widely used cartridge in the United States. The silver bullet has a diameter of 0.75 inches and a length of 2.17 inches, making it an impressive piece to hold and admire.
If you are a fan of unique silver products, Bullion Trading LLC also offers a 1 oz silver bullet and a 5 oz silver bullet. The 1 oz silver bullet features a design based on the .45 caliber round, while the 5 oz silver bullet is modeled after the 12 gauge shotgun shell. Both of these bullets are made from .999 pure silver and come with a certificate of authenticity.
You can purchase the 2 oz (.308) Silver Bullet, as well as the 1 oz and 5 oz versions, from Bullion Trading LLC by visiting the following links:
1 oz silver bullet:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/1-oz-silver-bullet/
5 oz silver bullet:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/5-oz-silver-bullet/
In case you have any questions or concerns about the 2 oz (.308) Silver Bullet or any of the other silver bullets offered by Bullion Trading LLC, you can contact their customer service team via email at

Invest in this unique and impressive 2 oz (.308) Silver Bullet from Bullion Trading LLC and add a touch of sophistication to your silver investment portfolio.
